Facebook Creative Review · Batch 4 · August 10, 2026
Twelve ads, six concepts, not yet published. Set A is the flat graphic version, Set B is the photo version of the same message. Each ad is shown the way it will appear in the feed, with its full caption beside it. Captions include the required disclaimer lines. Use the Copy caption button when posting.

Post A01 ANTI-LEADGEN

You're a borrower. Not a lead.

Built from the bedrfinance angle (1 lender, not 5 call lists). Nobody else in the screenshot set attacks the quote-site model. Positions Parity as the direct lender that never resells info.
Caption, ready to paste

You filled out one form to get a rate. Why are five strangers calling you?

That's the quote-site business model. You're the product.

We're the lender. You talk to us, we quote it, we fund it. Your info never leaves the building.

DSCR loans for rental property investors, qualified on the rent, not your tax returns. Rates from 5.38%* and closings in as soon as 10 days.

DM us or comment QUOTE and we'll reach out. DSCR Lending Nationwide.

Business-purpose loans for non-owner-occupied investment property only. *Rates indicative and subject to full underwriting and market changes. Not a commitment to lend.

Post A02 BRRRR LIFECYCLE

The last step pays for the next deal.

Built from Dashrate's rehab-exit idea, widened to the full BUY, REHAB, RENT, REFI playbook. Parity owns step four. Speaks directly to flippers and BRRRR investors sitting on finished projects.
Caption, ready to paste

Buy it. Rehab it. Rent it. Then the step that pays for the next deal: the refi.

A 30-year DSCR refi qualifies on the rent the property just proved. Not your tax returns, not your W2s, not your DTI.

Your rehab capital comes back out and goes to work on the next address.

If your project is rented, or about to be, let's talk exit. DSCR Lending Nationwide.

Business-purpose loans for non-owner-occupied investment property only.

Post A03 EDUCATION

The whole underwrite fits on a napkin.

Built as the answer to Ridgepoint's 'What is a DSCR loan' explainer. Instead of a wall of icons, the entire formula on a napkin. Simplicity is the selling point.
Caption, ready to paste

Rent ÷ payment = DSCR. That's the whole underwrite.

1.0 or better and the property carries the loan. No tax returns, no W2s, no DTI anywhere in the formula.

Send us the address and the rent. We'll run your napkin math for real.

DSCR Lending Nationwide.

Post A04 CASH-OUT EQUITY

Your rental has been saving up.

Built from Prospera's cash-out refi ad with a sharper hook: the rental has been saving the down payment for the next one. Equity recycling for owners who want to scale.
Caption, ready to paste

Every payment your tenant makes buys you equity. Most investors let it sit there.

A DSCR cash-out refi turns that equity into the down payment on the next property. Qualified on rent, not tax returns.

Keep the doors. Keep the cash flow. Redeploy the capital.

Rates from 5.38%* and closings in as soon as 10 days. DM us the property address and we'll show you what's possible.

Business-purpose loans for non-owner-occupied investment property only. *Rates indicative and subject to full underwriting and market changes. Not a commitment to lend.

Post A05 SPEED PROOF

10 days, day by day.

Everyone in the screenshot set claims speed (truehold 10 days, Bello 10 days, Atlas 7 days). Nobody shows it. The day-by-day timeline makes the claim credible instead of generic.
Caption, ready to paste

Ten days is not a slogan. It's a checklist.

Day 1: file in. One property, one rent schedule. Day 3: appraisal ordered, title opened. Day 6: conditions cleared. Day 10: clear to close.

DSCR files move fast because there's less to verify. No tax returns, no W2s, no employment calls.

Got a closing date bearing down on you? Start the clock. DSCR Lending Nationwide.

Business-purpose loans for non-owner-occupied investment property only. *“As soon as” timing, illustrative timeline. Subject to full underwriting, appraisal and title. Not a commitment to lend.

Post A06 DEAL POST-MORTEM

Declined. Declined. Closed.

The deal-teardown wedge from the strategy playbook. The whole category runs feature lists; nobody tells the story of a file. Two bank declines, one DSCR question, funded.
Caption, ready to paste

Two banks passed on the same file.

Bank #1 counted the borrower's personal debt and called the DTI too high. Bank #2 wanted two years of tax returns that a good CPA strategy made ugly on paper.

Same borrower, same property. One question changed the answer: does the lease cover the payment? It did. Funded.

That's DSCR. The property qualifies, not your paperwork. DSCR Lending Nationwide.

Illustrative example, not an actual transaction. Business-purpose loans for non-owner-occupied investment property only.
